content: Wenikamini nuiwarimana
Wenikamini niwemama mekanakɨne: mexɨakame, Wera, hutarieka mieme, 'Atsiweri, hairieka mieme, 'Akaraha,
Naurieka mieme, Nuka, meta 'auxɨwirieka mieme, Xapaha.
Wera niwemama mekanakɨne: 'Araxi, Keraha, 'Awihuri,
'Awitsuha, Nahamani, 'Akuhaki,
Keraha, Tsepupani meta Hirami.
'Ahuri niwemama, memanuyetekai yu'iwama memɨwanɨ'akai Kehewa mɨrakutewatsie memɨtitekai, 'arike memekɨ Manakati paitɨ, mekaniyɨakaitɨni:
Nahamani, 'Ahiyaxi meta Keraha, 'Utsa paapaya meta 'Akihuri. Keraha katiniuyurieni Manakati paitɨ mɨwarewitɨ.
Tsakarahini 'arike yu'ɨitama waruku'eirieku Kutsini meta Waraha, tawari kaniwarayexeiya yuniwema Muhawi kwieyaritsie.
Yu'ɨya Huretsi matɨa Kuwawi kanayexeiya meta Tsiwiha, Metsaha, Marikani,
Kehutsi, Tsakiyaxi meta Mixima. 'Ikɨ niwemama menanuyetei memɨwanɨ'a yu'iwama mekanakɨne.
Kutsini matɨata kaneyexeiya 'Awituwi meta 'Eripari.
'Eripari niwemama makanakɨne: 'Ewexi, Mitsani meta Tsemeri. Tsemeri kiekarite 'Unuhu meta Ruri kaniutiwewieni, meta kiekari 'etsimuyeyeu wa'aurie mamanetɨka,
Weriya meta Tsema memanuyetei memɨwanɨ'a mekanakɨne 'Ayaruni kiekatari wahetsiemieme, meta mekaniwarutaweiya Kahati kiekatari.
Weriya niwemama mekanakɨne: 'Akihu, Tsatsaki, Keremuti,
Tsewariyaxi, 'Arari, 'Arexi,
Mikaheri, 'Itsipa meta Yuká.
Tsewariyaxi, Metsurani, Hitsiki, 'Ewexi,
'Itsimerahi, Ketsiriyaxi meta Kuwawi, mɨkɨ mekanakɨne 'Eripari niwemama.
Yakini, Tsikɨri, Tsawiri,
'Erihenahi, Tsiretahi, 'Eriheri,
'Arahiyaxi, Werahiyaxi meta Tsimɨrati, mɨkɨ mekanakɨne Tsimi niwemama.
'Itsipani, 'Ewexi, 'Eriheri,
'Awuruni, Tsikɨri, Kanahani,
Kananiyaxi, 'Erami, 'Anatutiyaxi,
'Ipirahiyaxi meta Peniheri, mɨkɨ mepakɨ Tsatsaki niwemama.
Tsamɨtserahi, Tsehariyaxi, 'Atahariyaxi,
Karetsiyaxi, 'Eriyaxi meta Tsikɨri, mɨkɨ mekanakɨne Keruhani niwemama.
Kemaine wanuiwari xapayari, mɨkɨ memanuyetei memɨwanɨ'a mepakɨ meta Kerutsareme mepɨkiekataritɨkai.
Kehiheri Kawahuni paapaya, Kawahuni kanikiekametɨkaitɨni. 'Ɨyaya pɨtitewakai Mahaka.
Niwemama mepakɨ 'Awuruni matɨari mieme, Tsuxi, Kihitsi, Wahari, Nexi, Narawi,
Keruxi, 'Akihu, Tsekexi
meta Mikuruti, mɨkɨ Tsimaha paapaya matɨa. Meta 'ikɨ Kerutsareme mepɨtitekai yu'iwama wahetsɨa.
Nexi Kihitsi paapaya kanayani, mɨkɨta Tsahuri paapaya kanayani, mɨkɨta Kunatani paapaya matɨa, meta Marikitsuha, 'Awinarawi metatsiere 'Etsiwahari.
Kunatani Meriwahari paapaya kanayani, mɨkɨta Mikahiyaxi paapaya kanayani.
Mikahiyaxi niwemama mekanakɨne Pituhuni, Mereki, Tareya meta 'Akatsi.
'Akatsi Kuhara paapaya kanayani, mɨkɨta 'Aremeti paapaya kanayani meta 'Atsimaweti meta Tsimɨri. Tsimɨri Mutsaha paapaya kanayani,
Mutsaha Winaha paapaya kanayani, mɨkɨta Xapaha paapaya kanayani, Xapaha 'Eratsa paapaya kanayani, mɨkɨta 'Atseri paapaya kanayani.
'Atseri 'ataxewime yuniwema puwarayexei, mekatenitetewakaitɨni: 'Atsirikani, Wukuru, 'Itsimaheri, Tsehariyaxi, 'Awiriyaxi meta Kanahani. 'Ikɨ mekanakɨne 'Atseri niwemama.
'Iwaya 'Etseki niwemama mekanakɨne: mexɨakame, 'Urani, hutarieka mieme, Kehutsi, hairieka mieme, 'Eripereti.

'Urani niwemama meheuyutakwiwawetɨ mekanakɨne meta metemɨiwawetɨ tupikɨ. Waɨkawa yuniwema mekaniwarayexeiya meta yuteukarima: yunaitɨ xeitsienituyari heimana huta tewiyari heimana tamamata (150) mekaniyupaɨmekaitɨni. Yunaitɨ mɨkɨ Wenikamini nuiwarimama mekanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni.
